hiddenReasons.replaced_by_pi_labs: inventory unit of a school whose CS departments are shown as PI labs

rule: A lab is in the CS atlas when its field is computer_and_information_sciences or its recorded department matches departmentPattern (case-insensitive), or it is a PI lab of the CS departments view (csScopeReason cs_department_pi_lab, marked by the build). In the CS view a lab is grouped under its computing department labels; a lab with none keeps its recorded departments.
shown: The atlas shows, at a school of the CS departments view, that school's PI labs with at least one lab paper (atlas/data/cs-hierarchy; its inventory units are hidden as replaced_by_pi_labs), and at every other university the in-scope CS units with at least one linked paper in any publication view (others hidden as no_papers). Hidden records stay on disk.
